title: Require Artifact Directory Aggregate Shape
forbids: domain artifact source directories outside the positive artifact blueprint topology
why: Every selected domain artifact directory owns one index and one or more immutable data-product modules. Closing that positive physical directory shape makes its direct membership auditable while the typed defineArtifactCatalog API owns registered module compatibility without a second source parser.
remediate: Keep only index.ts and one or more *.artifact.ts modules in each selected domain artifacts directory. Inline artifact-private schemas and move genuinely shared primitives to the owning domain model.
message: Artifact directories must match the positive artifact blueprint source topology.
